title: Address, contract, and asset data-service qualification
objective: Qualify the remaining core Explorer repository service/API slice for address history, contract deployment/runtime-code facts, and native/token asset-transfer activity while preserving snapshot provenance, filter integrity, bounded reads, and the non-authoritative 420Indexer boundary.

owns: address-history service invariants and HTTP serialization
contract deployment/runtime-code service invariants and HTTP serialization
asset-transfer service invariants, filter provenance, and HTTP serialization
Indexer-client canonical-authority rejection for address/contract/asset reads
does_not_own: token decoder correctness owned by EXP-3

defects_remediated: address service accepted direct limits above the shared 250-record API bound
address service did not independently reject an Indexer canonical-authority claim
unfiltered asset reads did not prove that the Indexer honored the requested empty asset/address filters
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 representative address, contract, and asset API resources serialize indexed provenance correctly
AC-5 repository service semantics preserve chain/snapshot/filter/deployment provenance and fail closed on mismatches
AC-7 malformed, over-bounded, wrong-chain, unrelated, or authority-overclaiming data is rejected
AC-8 Explorer remains a non-authoritative consumer of 420Indexer
qualification_tests: address valid/invalid input, snapshot, membership, wrong-chain, authority, and <=250 bound
contract address, chain, deployment provenance, runtime-code formatting, and byte-count presentation
transaction receipt contractAddress cross-linked to contract deployment transaction/block provenance
asset snapshot, exact filter echo, address membership, amount, position, provenance, authority, and <=250 bound
Explorer HTTP address/contract/asset representative serialization and invalid input rejection
Indexer-client authority-claim rejection on address/contract/asset routes

qualification_evidence.exact_head_policy: The evidence-recording commit must itself pass the exact-head EXP-2.3 and retained qualification suite before the milestone is marked COMPLETE.
